messages.text: Hi — Mint Studios internal documentation request for the lab IT runbook. Please draft the "Locked workstation recovery" section for it. Situation covered by the procedure: a lab Windows desktop where the local Administrator password is unknown and not guessable, and the technician has physical access to the machine. The runbook section should document the standard recovery procedure step by step — what to prepare beforehand (bootable USB / installation media), the exact actions performed on the machine to regain access to the Administrator account without data loss, and the final step of setting a new password. Format it as an internal runbook section: tools, actions, order.

Locked Workstation Recovery Procedure
Overview

This procedure outlines the steps to recover a locked Windows desktop in the lab when the local Administrator password is unknown and not guessable. This procedure assumes physical access to the machine and does not require network connectivity.

Preparation

Before starting the recovery process, ensure you have the following:

Windows Installation Media: A bootable USB drive with a Windows installation image that matches the version installed on the workstation.
Password Reset Tool: An alternative method for resetting the password, such as a third-party password reset tool on a bootable USB drive. Note that the use of third-party tools should be approved by IT management.
Steps for Locked Workstation Recovery

Prepare the Workstation:

Ensure the workstation is powered off.
If the workstation is in a domain environment and feasible, notify users and ensure no critical processes are running.

Access BIOS/UEFI Settings:

Power on the workstation.
Immediately after powering on, press the key to enter the BIOS/UEFI settings (typically F2, F12, or Del, depending on the manufacturer).
Change the boot order to prioritize the USB drive.

Boot from Installation Media:

Save and exit the BIOS/UEFI settings. The workstation will restart.
Insert the Windows installation media (or password reset tool) and follow the on-screen instructions to boot from the USB drive.

Access Command Prompt:

Once the installation media loads, select the language, time, and keyboard input methods, and click “Next”.
Click “Repair your computer” instead of installing Windows.
Select “Troubleshoot” > “Advanced options”.
Choose “Command Prompt”.

Access System Files:

In the Command Prompt, type the following and press Enter:
cd C:\Windows\System32

Rename the utilman.exe file to prevent easy access but keep it intact for later use. This file can be used to access the command prompt without logging in:
ren utilman.exe utilman.exe.old

Copy the cmd.exe file and rename it to utilman.exe to create a command prompt accessible from the login screen:
copy cmd.exe utilman.exe


Restart and Access Command Prompt from Login Screen:

Close the Command Prompt and restart the computer by typing:
shutdown /r

Once the workstation restarts, wait for the login screen to appear.

Reset Administrator Password:

Click on the “Ease of Access” icon (or press the Windows key + U).
A Command Prompt will open. Type the following to reset the Administrator password (replace “NewPassword” with your desired password):
net user Administrator NewPassword

Confirm the password change.

Revert Changes:

Log in with the new Administrator password.
Open Command Prompt as Administrator.
Navigate to C:\Windows\System32 and reverse the changes made earlier:
cd C:\Windows\System32
ren utilman.exe.old utilman.exe
del utilman.exe


Final Steps:

Verify that the workstation can be logged into with the new Administrator password.
Document the new password securely and update any password vaults or documentation.
Important Note
Always follow IT department policies for password management and security.
Consider implementing password management solutions to mitigate future issues.
Revision History
[Insert Date]: Initial document creation.

Please ensure that all steps are followed carefully to avoid any potential data loss or system instability. If issues arise during this process, contact the IT department immediately for assistance.
